text:
Not entres dócilmente in esa buena night,

That to the final of the day debería the vejez arder and delirar;

Enfurécete, enfurécete ante the death of the light.


Aunque the sabios entienden to the final that the oscuridad is it correcto,

As a his verbo ningún rayo ha confiado vigor,

Not entran dócilmente in esa buena night.


Llorando the hombres buenos, to the llegar the last ola

For the brillo with that his frágiles obras pudieron haber danzado in a verde bahía,

Is enfurecen, is enfurecen ante the death of the light.


And the locos, that to the sol cogieron to the vuelo in his cantares,

And advierten, demasiado tarde, the ofensa that le hacían,

Not entran dócilmente in esa buena night.


And the hombres graves, that cerca of the death with the vista that is apaga

Ven that esos eyes ciegos pudieron brillar as meteoros and be alegres,

Is enfurecen, is enfurecen ante the death of the light.


And tú, father mio, allá in your cima sad,

Maldíceme or bendíceme with your fieras lágrimas, it ruego.

Not entres dócilmente in esa buena night.

Enfurécete, enfurécete ante the death of the light.

translation.title: Not entres dócilmente in esa buena night
